scope: Verified primary articles and official publisher guides relevant to plant cross-species single-cell foundation models, annotation benchmarks, atlas resources and supplementary-package design.
update_policy: Add only primary articles or official publisher guidance. Record the URL, journal, year, figure roles and reusable principle. Do not copy published artwork or proprietary templates.

anchors.title: scGPT: toward building a foundation model for single-cell multi-omics using generative AI
anchors.figure_pattern: Method overview first; core annotation benchmark second; downstream capabilities and interpretability separated into later figures.
anchors.reuse_rule: Do not make one page carry architecture, benchmark, biology and deployment at once.

anchors.title: Nicheformer: a foundation model for single-cell and spatial omics
anchors.figure_pattern: Fig. 1 connects corpus, metadata, tokenization, architecture and task scope; data scale and benchmark/application evidence have dedicated figures.
anchors.reuse_rule: Use a schematic-led overview with a quantified corpus panel and a real use-case panel.

anchors.title: Universal cell embedding provides a foundation model for cell biology
anchors.figure_pattern: Zero-shot protocol definition, unseen-data embedding, cross-species example and ontology-consistency validation are distinct evidence layers.
anchors.reuse_rule: Show the held-out protocol before the numerical result and use UMAP only as a complement to quantitative evidence.

anchors.title: scPlantLLM: A Foundation Model for Exploring Single-cell Expression Atlases in Plants
anchors.figure_pattern: Foundation workflow and embedding; separate zero-shot test datasets; fine-tuning separated from zero-shot; later GRN and efficiency panels.
anchors.reuse_rule: Keep strict zero-shot, few-shot adaptation and operations as separately titled protocols.

anchors.title: Orthologous marker groups reveal broad cell identity conservation across plant single-cell transcriptomes
anchors.figure_pattern: Ortholog-aware workflow plus multispecies coverage followed by cross-species heatmap, UMAP and significance evidence.
anchors.reuse_rule: Make plant gene-family and one-to-many ortholog handling visible in the cross-species evidence chain.

anchors.title: A single-cell, spatial transcriptomic atlas of the Arabidopsis life cycle
anchors.figure_pattern: Atlas acquisition and coverage first; marker and spatial validation second; biological discovery follows.
anchors.reuse_rule: A biological case must progress from cells to marker evidence to an interpretable biological statement.

anchors.title: A unified cell atlas of vascular plants reveals cell-type foundational genes and accelerates gene discovery
anchors.figure_pattern: Cross-species resource, foundational-gene discovery, biological validation and automated annotation tool form a resource-to-discovery loop.
anchors.reuse_rule: Frame Plant-CellFM as a reusable biological discovery resource, not only a classifier.

anchors.title: Nature final-submission artwork guidance
anchors.figure_pattern: Two-column figure width, small bold panel labels, editable vector text and traceable statistical source data.
anchors.reuse_rule: Use 180-183 mm double-column layouts, 5-7 pt final text, 8 pt bold panel labels and editable vector exports.
